lore_summary.en: The chronicle closes where it began: with fire, with iron, with kings.
lore_summary.fa: شاهنامه آنجا پایان می‌یابد که آغاز کرد: با آتش، با آهن، با شاهان. در کیهان‌شناسی زرتشتی تاریخ به سوی فرشکرت پیش می‌رود — نوسازی جهان که نیکی شر را کامل شکست می‌دهد. آخرین جنگ اعصار، جنگ بین فراموشی و یادآوری است. شاهنامه هزار سال پیش طرفش را انتخاب کرد و هنوز می‌جنگد.

scenes.body_en: The chronicle closes where it began: with fire, with iron, with kings. Ferdowsi's verses outlive the empires they describe. What was once a kingdom of crystal becomes a kingdom of memory, and every reader joins the lineage of Pars.

In Zoroastrian cosmology, time has always moved toward a final reckoning — the Frashokereti, the renovation of existence, when good defeats evil completely and the world is made new. The Shahnameh is not a religious text, but it carries this shape. Every king who held the Farr was holding back the dark. Every fall was a setback in a war that had not ended. The Arab conquest was not the conclusion — it was the latest turn of a wheel that had been turning since Keyumars first stood on his mountain and fire first burned.

What ends in the Shahnameh is not Iran. What ends is the particular form Iran had taken: the Sasanian court, the Zoroastrian state religion, the Kayanian bloodline that the poem had been tracing since the first chapter. Those things ended. Iran did not. The language survived. The stories survived. The names survived. Ferdowsi built a vessel out of sixty thousand couplets and put everything that mattered into it, and the vessel held.

The ages end as all ages end — not with silence but with the beginning of the next telling. A child somewhere is hearing the story of Rostam and Sohrab for the first time. A family is reciting Ferdowsi at a New Year's table. A scholar is opening a manuscript that is six hundred years old and finding the words still legible, still alive, still capable of the thing that only great poetry can do: make the dead speak and the distant near and the lost recoverable. The final war of ages is the war between forgetting and remembering. The Shahnameh chose its side a thousand years ago. It is still fighting.

battle.intro_en: The chronicle closes where it began: with fire, with iron, with kings who rose and fell. To face this final gate you must hold everything the Shahnameh has given you.
battle.intro_fa: دفتر آنجا می‌بندد که آغاز کرد: با آتش، با آهن، با شاهانی که برخاستند و فروافتادند. برای مواجهه با این دروازه‌ی آخر باید آنچه شاهنامه به تو داده را نگه داری.

battle.intro_tg: Солнома он ҷо мебандад, ки оғоз ёфт: бо оташ, бо оҳан, бо шоҳоне ки бархостанд ва фурӯ афтоданд. Барои рӯбарӯ шудан бо ин дарвозаи охирин бояд ҳамаеро, ки Шоҳнома ба ту додааст, нигоҳ дорӣ.
